title: Deep-learning early-warning score prospectively validated for ward adverse events in Korea
summary: In a prospective observational validation of 6,039 ward encounters (217 with major adverse events) at a Korean tertiary center, the VC-MAES deep-learning score reached an AUROC of 0.918 six hours before events, against 0.797 for NEWS and 0.722 for MEWS. Performance in the obstetrics and gynecology subgroup was AUROC 0.964. The AUPRC was 0.352, the setting is single-center, and the model was an existing commercial system.

evidence.tested: Prospective observational external validation compared with NEWS and MEWS.
evidence.unknown: Impact on patient outcomes and generalization beyond one center; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning score predicted major adverse events in general-ward patients.
